PluginData.Author: ColbyJack
PluginData.Tooltip: Play in a SteamVR headset with motion controls.
PluginData.Description:
A native-feeling VR experience for Space Engineers via SteamVR.
- Interactive vanilla and DLC cockpits: grab the joysticks, throttles, steering wheels and buttons - Motion-controlled tools and weapons, with two-handed and left-handed holds - VR building with painting, symmetry, blueprints and voxel tools - 3rd person, spectator, camera, turret and remote-grid views - Wrist HUD and tablet, radial menus, a VR keyboard and all game menus in VR - Interactive LCDs, including Arthur and TouchScreenAPI - Multiplayer - NVIDIA DLAA and DLSS upscaling on RTX GPUs (Windows) - Pulsar Legacy and Interim, with experimental native Linux support
Start SteamVR before launching. DLSS is off by default; Windows installs download NVIDIA's nvngx_dlss.dll runtime (31 MB download); when enabled, DLSS loads it with the NVIDIA driver's NGX library, and it stays off while the NVIDIA DLSS plugin is loaded. On Linux, install your distribution's libgdiplus package. Full feature list, controls and issues: https://github.com/ColbyJack1134/SpaceEngineersVR
